sentences.text: For anyone choosing a coding agent, the evidence leaves three practical takeaways.
sentences.spoken: For anyone choosing a coding agent, the evidence leaves three practical takeaways.

sentences.text: First, the harness is part of the result: a peer-reviewed study shows that changing the interface can change what the same model achieves.

sentences.text: Second, no design wins everywhere; advantages reverse across models and tasks.

sentences.text: Third, measure on your own work, including whether added coordination earns its cost.
